title: FHGM native gene-model record contract 0.1
description: Native FHGM model record selected independently of its enclosing FHGFF3 file header. The native contract defines record structure; the separate model-level checker establishes model ID uniqueness, eligible feature-target resolution, record/file reference agreement and bounded immediate-predecessor resolution. Base-header validity, exact-byte integrity, feature/biology validity and curator acceptance remain separate outcomes. The reviewed source and development decisions are preserved at https://github.com/FAIR-bioHeaders/FHGM-Specification/blob/d9d131a02b042023f4784d842a874232fc891069/development/CONTRACT-REVIEW.md. Model-contract selection introduces no FHGM header schemaVersion or in-record schema field.

modelId.description: Draft (#204: model identity and scope; reviewed 2026-11-14). Opaque model identifier, unique within one annotation snapshot and stable across a revision of the same model on the same assembly. File-local identity is the default and needs no minting authority; a producer-supplied external identifier may occupy this field, with its authority recorded beside it. Who may mint external model IDs is still a curator question.

modelVersion.description: Draft (#204: model identity and scope; reviewed 2026-11-14). Opaque model version, kept opaque through v0.x: equality and difference only. An immediate revision must use a value different from its predecessor; no ordering is implied, claimed or checked, and ordering requirements await curator use cases the pilots did not supply.

featureId.description: Draft (#204: model identity and scope; reviewed 2026-11-14). Exact decoded local GFF3 feature ID targeted by this record. The v0.1 default resolves one root gene row (no Parent); transcript-only scope stays open (#204 Q6, curator decision). Resolution is a model-level check, not a schema constraint.

reference.description: Draft (#204: reference coordinates; required by deviation D1, confirmed 2026-11-14). Reference assembly binding carried on the record so it stays interpretable when extracted from its file. Mirrors the FHGFF3 genome-link alternative: an FHR parent checksum, or an assembly accession with the supplied SeqCol digest; both forms may be supplied. The model-level check requires at least one form comparable with the enclosing FHGFF3 header's genome link and rejects any contradiction of it, so a record bound by an FHR checksum is not accepted in a file whose link is an accession plus digest. Never inferred; values are producer-supplied assertions.

annotates.description: FHR-family checksum of the annotated genome file, when the record is bound to an FHR parent rather than asserted by accession and digest

predecessor.description: Draft (#204: new and revised models). Immediate same-assembly predecessor: the prior annotation snapshot's file checksum with the prior record's model ID and version. Absent means no revision claim. A resolved pointer identifies a predecessor record; it never asserts curator acceptance.

annotationChecksum.description: Exact-byte checksum of the prior annotation snapshot file

modelId.description: Predecessor model ID; it must equal this record's own modelId (deviation D2, confirmed 2026-11-14). Model renames belong to the split/merge semantics #204 Q6 leaves open, so v0.x admits none.

modelVersion.description: Predecessor model version, exactly as recorded in the prior snapshot

contributors.description: Draft (#204: credit and publication). Supplied model contributors and their roles. File metadata authors stay in the FHGFF3 metadataAuthor field; article authorship, journal review and curator acceptance stay outside this record.

nameType.description: DataCite nameType, mirroring the shared FHGFF3 Author object

uri.description: ORCID URI, mirroring the shared FHGFF3 Author object

evidence.description: Draft (#204: evidence and methods). Supplied evidence statements for the model. These are producer assertions, distinct from validation results; the feature layer and external tools remain the place where evidence is checked.

uri.description: Location of the cited evidence, when one was supplied

methods.description: Draft (#204: evidence and methods). Computational methods: software with versions, a protocol reference, and supplied limitations or uncertainty.

protocol.description: Curation protocol or workflow reference URI, mirroring the FHGFF3 annotationProtocol role

publication.description: Draft (#204: credit and publication). Publication context of the model contribution. The article and the deposited model data keep separate, independently resolvable identities; the assembly identity stays in reference.

article.description: Article DOI, mirroring the FHGFF3 scholarlyArticle pattern

deposit.description: Identifiers of the deposited model data, mirroring the FHGFF3 identifier curie pattern

reuseConditions.description: Draft (#204: packaging and integrity). Reuse conditions supplied for this model record; not inferred from the article or file license.

text.description: A non-empty opaque string with no leading or trailing whitespace (Unicode whitespace included) and no control, zero-width or bidirectional formatting character anywhere (C0, DEL, C1, U+200B-U+200F, U+202A-U+202E, U+2060-U+2064, U+FEFF), so two values that print alike cannot differ invisibly. Identifier uniqueness is additionally compared after Unicode NFC normalisation by the model-level checker.

link.description: A URI whose scheme is one the shared docs/FORMAT.md R14 accepts: http, https or ftp with // and a host, or a urn:, doi: or info: identifier, the scheme compared without regard to letter case. The released header types only warn about other schemes; this draft record contract rejects them (for example javascript:, data:, vbscript: and file:), so a renderer can link every accepted value. format: uri still rejects whitespace and control characters anywhere.

curie.description: prefix:local identifier, mirroring the FHGFF3 identifier curie pattern, with the text constraints applied: the local part starts with a non-whitespace character and the value has no trailing whitespace or control character

genomeReference.description: Mirrors the FHGFF3 1.1 GenomeReference object: accession and supplied SeqCol digest are required; assemblyName is optional and, when present, non-blank text
